"''''Ninth'' time. That business on Cato Neimoidia doesn't… doesn't count.|Anakin Skywalker and Obi-Wan Kenobi|{{Film|III}}}} Early in the [[Clone Wars]], [[Jedi Master]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi]] of the [[Jedi High Council]] was sent on a '''mission to Cato Neimoidia''' to find the cause of the [[Cadesura disaster]] on the [[planet]] [[Cato Neimoidia]] in the [[Colonies]] region of [[the galaxy]]. Joined by his former [[Padawan]] [[Anakin Skywalker]], who had recently become a [[Jedi Knight]] and disobeyed orders by arriving on planet to help Kenobi, the two Jedi became involved in a dangerous incident, which nearly [[Death|cost]] Kenobi his life. During the mission, Kenobi first met [[Dark Acolyte]] [[Asajj Ventress]], the [[Sith apprentice]] of the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems]] leader [[Count]] [[Dooku]]. Skywalker considered it one of many [[time]]s he saved his former mentor, yet Kenobi disagreed. ==Prelude== In [[22 BBY]],''[[Star Wars: Galactic Atlas]]'' the [[Separatist Crisis|political crisis]] ongoing in the [[Galactic Republic]] over thousands of [[star system]]s attempting to secede and form the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems]] erupted into full-scale war at the [[First Battle of Geonosis]], beginning the [[Clone Wars]]. Although [[Viceroy]] [[Nute Gunray]], leader of the [[Trade Federation]], was a member of the [[Executive Separatist Council]],{{Film|II}} the Federation officially claimed neutrality in the conflict, stating that Gunray was an extremist who no longer represented its views.{{TCW|Sphere of Influence}} As a result, the [[Colonies]]''[[Ultimate Star Wars]]'' [[planet]] [[Cato Neimoidia]], where the corporation's headquarters were located,{{Databank|cato-neimoidia|Cato Neimoidia}} was also considered neutral. A few [[Standard week|weeks]] after the beginning of the war, a [[Cadesura disaster|bombing]] occurred in [[Zarra]], Cato Neimoidia's [[capital]] [[city]], which resulted in significant damage and [[death]]s. With the planet's neutrality threatened, the Republic and Confederacy both sent emissaries to investigate the incident. The Republic was represented by [[Jedi Master]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi]], while [[Count]] [[Dooku]], the fallen [[Jedi]] turned [[Sith Lord]] who publicly led the Separatists, sent his [[Sith apprentice|apprentice]], the [[assassin]] [[Asajj Ventress]]. ==The mission== [[File:SW41-Ventresscover.png|thumb|left|250px|Obi-Wan Kenobi and Anakin Skywalker properly met Asajj Ventress (pictured) for the first time during the mission to Cato Neimoidia.]] Arriving on Cato Neimoidia, Kenobi was met by [[Minister]] [[Alluv Eyam]]. He also met Ventress, who made a show out of inspecting him for recording devices and took an interest in an elaborately-plated [[Scanner|scanning device]] Kenobi had received as a gift from a friend. Claiming she had never met a Jedi before, Ventress stated that Dooku had spoken highly of the [[Jedi Order]]. While Kenobi's belongings were delivered to his assigned quarters, the Neimoidians took him and Ventress on a brief tour of Zarra. During the tour, Kenobi attempted to suss out Ventress' personality and motivations by questioning her, although she deflected them. Kenobi was, however, intrigued by a slip of the [[tongue]] the [[Dark Acolyte]] made where she referred to Dooku as "Master", wondering if it referred to the Separatist hierarchy or something more. After the tour, the visitors were taken to the blast site, where an inspector showed Kenobi and Ventress the damage that had been done, discussing casualties and those who had survived. Ventress noticed something and asked that the [[shuttle]] be stopped, pointing out a series of six blast points to Kenobi which suggested a deliberate attack. The weeks Kenobi had spent getting to know the [[clone trooper]]s of the [[Republic Military]] suggested to him that the attack was some kind of military operation, which Ventress directly questioned him about. As Ventress wondered what they would find in other areas, Kenobi diplomatically suggested that it required investigation. Eyam said he would be bringing them to view the damage at the surface level, which Kenobi agreed to, requesting to see as much of the destruction as possible for investigative purposes. Kenobi also suggested to Ventress that they might find common ground between their governments, to which Ventress responded that such a thing might be possible if he could win her over. As the mission continued, Kenobi teamed up with [[Neimoidian Royal Guard]]swoman [[Ruug Quarnom]]. [[Jedi Knight]] [[Anakin Skywalker]], Kenobi's recently-promoted former [[Padawan]], disobeyed orders to come to Cato Neimoidia, accompanied by promising but conflicted [[Jedi Initiate|Jedi youngling]] [[Mill Alibeth]] and the [[astromech droid]] [[R2-D2]]. In the course of events, the Jedi became involved in a dangerous incident which nearly cost Kenobi his life, although Skywalker claimed to have saved him; in the [[Grand Theatre of Judgment]], Kenobi called upon his hidden [[Obi-Wan Kenobi's third lightsaber|lightsaber]] upon being surrounded by Neimoidian guards, only for Skywalker to rush in to Kenobi's surprise, helping to block the blaster bolts but also getting in the way of Kenobi's blade before Kenobi could do it himself. Skywalker and Ventress then clashed, with Ventress revealing she already knew him. ==Aftermath== The Cato Neimoidian government's attempts at remaining neutral ultimately ended in failure. The planet eventually fell under Separatist control, which inspired the Republic{{BuildR2Cite|44|Droid Directory}} to launch a [[conquest of Cato Neimoidia]].{{HelmetCollectionCite|9|Databank A-Z}} The world continued to be a center for fighting afterward, with Skywalker, arriving alongside his apprentice [[Ahsoka Tano]] and his [[501st Legion]], returning to the planet{{TCW|Sabotage (episode)}} when the Separatists tried to take back Cato Neimoidia. The Separatist victory led to another [[Battle of Cato Neimoidia]] during the [[Outer Rim Sieges]].''[[Star Wars: Battles that Changed the Galaxy]]'' By [[19 BBY]], the final [[Standard year|year]] of the Clone Wars, Skywalker considered himself to have saved Kenobi's life on at least nine other occasions, including during the [[Battle of Coruscant]]. In the aftermath of that battle, Skywalker mentioned to Kenobi that he had saved him ten times, but Kenobi corrected him to nine, insisting that what had occurred on Cato Neimoidia did not count. ==Behind the scenes== {{Quote|So, if you want to treat ''Labyrinth of Evil'' as "that business," nothing that happens in my book will negate that. They take place at two different points in the timeline, so they can totally co-exist. It's totally cool.|Mike Chen|{{WebCite|url=https://www.talkingbay94.com/2022/05/11/mike-chen-author-of-star-wars-brotherhood|text=Mike Chen: Author of Star Wars - BROTHERHOOD|work=''Talking Bay 94''|archivedate=20220511161716}}}} The mission to Cato Neimoidia was first mentioned, indirectly, in the [[2005]] film [[Star Wars: Episode III Revenge of the Sith|''Star Wars'': Episode III ''Revenge of the Sith'']]. It first appeared in the [[2022]] novel [[Brotherhood (novel)|''Brotherhood'']], written by [[Mike Chen (author)|Mike Chen]]. In the [[Star Wars Legends|''Star Wars'' Legends]] continuity, the event was depicted as the [[Siege of Cato Neimoidia|Battle of Cato Neimoidia]] in the 2005 novel ''[[Labyrinth of Evil]]'', written by [[James Luceno]] and set immediately prior to the events of ''Revenge of the Sith''.''[[Labyrinth of Evil]]'' "[[Anakin Skywalker (reference book)|Anakin Skywalker]]," a [[2021]] booklet in the [[Star Wars Encyclopedia (series)|''Star Wars Encyclopedia'']] published by [[De Agostini]], gave a description of [[Assault on Cato Neimoidia|Kenobi and Skywalker's mission]] which roughly corresponded with the Legends depiction, stating they had gone on the mission just before the [[Battle of Yerbana]],{{EncyclopediaCite|Anakin Skywalker}} which occurred just before the [[Battle of Coruscant]]{{TCW|Old Friends Not Forgotten}} that opens ''Revenge of the Sith''. Chen has stated fans are able to continue to believe the events of ''Labyrinth of Evil'' are the business mentioned in ''Revenge of the Sith'' because nothing in his book contradicts its events. ==Appearances== *''[[Star Wars Battlefront II]]'' {{Imo}} {{DLC}} *[[Brotherhood (novel)|''Brotherhood'']] {{Ab|Brotherhood (audiobook)}} {{1st}} {{1stID|mission to Cato Neimoidia}} *{{Film|III}} {{1stm}} {{Imo}} ==Sources== *''[[Ultimate Star Wars]]'' {{Imo}} *''[[Ultimate Star Wars, New Edition]]'' {{Imo}} *{{SW|url=news/new-books-revealed|text=New Books Starring Luke and Lando, Obi-Wan and Anakin, and More Revealed – Exclusive}} *{{SW|url=news/star-wars-brotherhood-cover|text=Anakin and Obi-Wan Are Ready for Battle on the Cover of ''Star Wars: Brotherhood'' – Exclusive Reveal}} *{{InsiderCite|207|Launchpad}} *{{SW|url=news/star-wars-brotherhood-exclusive-excerpt|text=Obi-Wan Kenobi Meets Asajj Ventress in ''Star Wars: Brotherhood'' – Exclusive Excerpt}} *{{SW|url=news/obi-wan-kenobi-everything-you-need-to-know|text=Obi-101: Everything You Need to Know About Obi-Wan Kenobi}} *{{InsiderCite|223|Dexter Jettster: Pan-Galactic Besalisk of Mystery}} *''[[Star Wars Encyclopedia: The Comprehensive Guide to the Star Wars Galaxy]]'' *{{SW|url=news/who-is-ventress|text=Who Is Asajj Ventress?}} ==Notes and references== {{Reflist}} {{CanonCloneWarsNav}} {{Interlang |es=Misión a Cato Neimoidia (Kenobi y Skywalker) }} {{DEFAULTSORT:Cato Neimoidia (Kenobi and Skywalker), mission to}} [[Category:Battles of Cato Neimoidia]] [[Category:Lightsaber duels]] [[Category:Missions of the Clone Wars]]
